segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שׁוֹלֵחַ אָדָם יָרֵךְ לְגוֹי שֶׁגִּיד הַנָּשֶׁה בְּתוֹכָהּ, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁמְּקוֹמוֹ נִיכָּר.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» Although it is prohibited for Jews to eat the sciatic nerve, «a» Jewish «person» may «send» the «thigh» of an animal «to a gentile with the sciatic nerve in it,» without concern that the gentile will then sell the thigh to a Jew and the Jew will eat the sciatic nerve. This leniency is «due to» the fact «that the place» of the sciatic nerve «is conspicuous» in the thigh.

moves.cueHe: שולח אדם ירך לגוי שגיד הנשה בתוכה
moves.summary: the mishna permits sending a gentile a thigh with the sciatic nerve in it, giving as its reason that the nerve's place is conspicuous
